newsitem.title: USA: Seven-Up/RC says Q3 EBITDA rises.
newsitem.headline: Seven-Up/RC says Q3 EBITDA rises.

text.p: Seven-Up/RC Bottling Co of Southern California Inc said on Tuesday its third quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) rose to $3.5 million from $200,000 a year ago.
EBITDA for the nine months ended September 30 rose to $6.9 million from $2.7 million last year, the company said in a statement.
The company said it chose to disclose EBITDA figures because they are "a widely accepted financial indicator of a company's ability to service and/or incur indebtedness."

Seven-Up/RC Bottling said its net loss before income taxes and extraordinary items narrowed to $12.3 million for the nine months to September 30 from $23.6 million in the same period a year ago as a result of its reorganization and recent restructuring.

"The improvement for both the third quarter and nine months was driven by the combined result of higher case volume, improved volume mix of higher margin packages, lower raw material costs and a decrease in variable and fixed expenses," said Rick Ferguson, chief financial officer.
